```wolf
// std.list
fn any(xs: List[T], pred: fn(T) -> bool) -> bool
```

---

Does `pred` hold for ANY element? False on the empty list. Walks in
order and stops at the first hit.

Call shape (witnessed by `tests/list/predicate_tier.lu` on all
three lanes): `fn odd(v: int) -> bool { v % 2 == 1 }` … then
`list.any(xs, odd)`.
